candidate.rule_context:
COMPLIANCE NOTE - Influencer Disclosure Requirements

Any social media post created as part of a compensated partnership, sponsored arrangement, or material-connection relationship with Northwind Brands must carry a clear and conspicuous disclosure of that relationship. This applies regardless of platform, format, or creator preference.

"Clear and conspicuous" means the disclosure is placed at the beginning of the post or caption (before any "read more" fold), is unambiguous in plain language, and uses a recognized disclosure tag such as #ad, #sponsored, or #paidpartnership. A disclosure buried at the end of a long caption, hidden among other hashtags, or phrased so vaguely that a reasonable consumer would not recognize it as advertising does not satisfy this requirement.

The obligation attaches the moment any form of compensation, free product, or other material connection exists between Northwind and the poster. It is not optional based on perceived authenticity, engagement performance, or creator preference for an untagged post. If the arrangement is paid, the disclosure is required. No exceptions, no soft calls, no "let the creator decide" judgment calls. When reviewing or drafting influencer copy, confirm the disclosure is present and properly placed before approving any caption set. If a caption lacks disclosure, add it or reject the caption. Do not recommend undisclosed paid posts for publication.

Any social media post created under a compensated partnership, sponsored arrangement, or other material connection with the company must carry a clear and conspicuous disclosure of that relationship. This applies regardless of platform, format, or creator preference.
